_style: cartoon dungeon foley, crisp close-mic, punchy, no music, no voices

punch.prompt: huge fist smashing through a stone ceiling, rock cracking and rubble crashing down

thud.prompt: heavy body landing on a stone floor, deep cartoon thud

lava_bubble.prompt: thick molten lava bubbling and blorping, slow gloopy pops, steady loop

lava_splash.prompt: heavy object plopping into thick molten lava, gloopy splash then sizzling hiss

crumble.prompt: stone bridge slab cracking and breaking away, rocks crumbling and falling

grind.prompt: heavy stone blocks grinding and rising into place, deep rumble

geyser.prompt: lava geyser erupting, pressure hiss building into a roaring molten blast

lava_flow.prompt: rushing river of molten lava, low roaring flow, steady loop

freeze.prompt: magic frost spell sweeping across, ice crackling and crystallizing quickly

coins.prompt: person diving into a big pile of gold coins, coins jingling and splashing

crack.prompt: thick ice cracking loudly under someone's feet, sharp splitting

gate.prompt: heavy iron hatches sliding open in a stone wall, metal scraping

wave.prompt: huge wave of molten lava rushing in and crashing, roaring flood

lute_sad.prompt: single lute playing three slow sad descending notes, sad trombone feeling, solo
